headline: CEAT expands its Sriperumbudur plant to produce high-end tyres
hook: Pushing deeper into premium global tyre markets
summary: CEAT has upgraded its manufacturing facility in Sriperumbudur, Chennai, to produce advanced tyre products. The plant will now manufacture 22-inch SUV tyres and seven truck and bus radial (TBR) sizes tailored for international markets. This expansion is part of the company's broader strategy to strengthen its footprint in the premium tyre segment. Indian retail investors should note this push toward higher-margin global product categories.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings reflecting premium segment margin impact
why_it_matters: Higher-margin global product sales could boost CEAT's long-term profitability.
winners_losers: CEAT gains / domestic budget peers unaffected
